closed_in_h3.note: Chromium now launches as unprivileged UID/GID with NoNewPrivs=1, renderer seccomp=2, no --no-sandbox flag, deny-by-default network routing, and is structurally bound to canonical browser_game_worker contract/blob.
Asset filenames include content-addressed SHA suffixes and duplicate materialized paths with conflicting hashes fail closed.
RuntimePackageManifest v2 binds a canonical self-hash for build-manifest.json; verifier rejects manifest tamper and untracked package files.
Build subprocesses use a minimal deterministic environment, no-new-privileges, new session, and RLIMIT CPU/address-space/process/open-file/file-size confinement.
Inherited dynamic __import__(json) was removed while browser sandbox code was rewritten; direct json import is used and AST scan reports no unsafe dynamic calls in H3 delta.

partial_in_h3.note: Static deployment origin with production security headers is verified and exact built module graph boots through native Chromium type=module loader. Combined browser navigation to the loopback origin cannot be proven in this host because managed Chromium URLBlocklist=["*"] returns ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR; no false closure claimed.
